crossRefs.note: But when the inhabitants of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done to Jericho and to Ai,
The children of Israel traveled and came to their cities on the third day. Now their cities were Gibeon, Chephirah…
Three of the thirty chief men went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the army of the Philistines…
Shaaraim, Adithaim and Gederah (or Gederothaim); fourteen cities with their villages.

people.name: Gederah
people.line: Town in Judah; home of Baal-hanan and Jozabad

people.name: Gibeon
people.line: Hivite city that tricked Joshua into a peace treaty.

people.name: Ishmaiah
people.line: Gibeonite warrior who joined David at Ziklag.

people.name: Jahaziel
people.line: Benjamite warrior who joined David at Ziklag.

people.name: Jeremiah
people.line: A Gadite warrior who joined David at Ziklag.

people.name: Johanan
people.line: A Benjaminite warrior who joined David at Ziklag

people.name: Jozabad
people.line: A Benjamite warrior who joined David at Ziklag
